FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Find answers about features, implementation, security, and how to get started with Nexora ERP.

whatIs.question: What is Nexora ERP?
whatIs.answer: Nexora ERP is an integrated business management platform that helps companies manage sales, inventory, customers, reports, branches, and other operational activities in one system.

custom.question: Can Nexora ERP be customized to fit my business needs?
custom.answer: Yes. The system can be tailored to specific business processes and requirements, including modules, workflows, integrations, and additional features.

multiBranch.question: Can Nexora ERP support multiple branches?
multiBranch.answer: Yes. The multi-branch feature allows businesses to centrally monitor transactions, inventory, performance, users, and reports across multiple locations.

security.question: Is my business data secure?
security.answer: Nexora ERP is designed with user access management and system controls to help keep business data secure and well managed. Final security standards will depend on the production implementation.

try.question: How can I try Nexora ERP?
try.answer: You can start with a free trial or schedule a demo with the Nexora team to explore a solution that fits your business needs.
